description: Shows the setup checklist of one webinar, the same list the dashboard shows: every step with its state, what is already done, what is still missing, and the readiness score from the last preflight check. Take it when a host asks what is left before the webinar can run, for example "What do I still have to do?" It needs the session and the webinar. It only reads. Steps the host ticked off by hand stay ticked off, and a missing step names the tool that can fix it. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: checklist, what is left, setup steps, ready to start, what is missing

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_get_webinar_checklist
title: Read the setup checklist of a webinar
